comparison.objective: Fill three drywall nail holes with spackle and strike the patches flush.
comparison.physical_skill: Load a putty knife, regulate blade angle and sliding contact, pack material, and skim the surface.
comparison.success_condition: All holes filled within depth tolerance, minimal proud area, knife set down; damaging corner-drag caps the score.
comparison.reason: This tests material transfer and surface finishing through continuous sliding contact, not impact, breakage, precision mandrel insertion, or fragment containment.
